decisions.reason: A formwork profile line close to the core offer with its own page, in an expanding firm whose results likely meet aspirations, gives no trigger for problemistic search.
Automated flow control fits the firm's automation strategy, and the firm's slack lets it carry a product whose results are still uncertain.
Shuttering magnet blocks are a low-cost line within the core formwork business, so there is little reason to drop them while the firm grows.
Magnetic formwork strips have their own page and fit the established range, so they likely perform at or above aspiration.
A magnetic formwork component with dedicated web presence complements the core range at little extra cost.
Only a mention on the website and overlap with similar components raise some risk of consolidation, but growth and slack favour keeping it.
